sentences.en: You pay for the convenience of living near a station.
sentences.zh: 你付钱享受住在车站附近的便利。

sentences.en: It is a great convenience to live near a station.
sentences.zh: 住在车站附近真是太方便了。

sentences.en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
sentences.zh: 有空的话你可以来我家喝杯茶。

senses.zh: 便利，有益；方便(的用具，机械等)
